author: /root/dependency_inventory
scope: Exactly 116 delivered new Lean files directly in the sixth-batch 30 task directories and their actual direct imports. Nested frozen prior-batch copies are excluded. Source inventory and installation suggestions only; no compilation or full transitive closure.
resolution_policy: Extract actual direct imports while ignoring nested comments/strings. Verify candidate hashes against exact candidate registry source records.

Prefer exact registry module/path/SHA pins and cross-check all available duplicate pins for each direct module. Only exact registry filenames may supplement module-less pins; no directory same-name search is performed.
Resolve exact pinned paths or deterministic production module paths only; mark AMBIGUOUS for multiple exact paths, MISSING for absence, PIN_MISMATCH for stale pins.
Explicit registry .txt-to-module mappings are allowed. Read exact long Windows paths with extended-length prefix after normalizing dot segments; stored authoritative paths and bytes are unchanged.
Absent Mathlib local source has null source hash and MISSING status, with the existing manifest revision retained. No external source is fetched or copied.

Only unresolved current direct module names may use exact entries from raw-verified frozen E/D inventories; their source bytes are rehashed and provenance retained. This is bounded lookup, not import recursion.
not_performed: No compiler/Lean/lake/checker, repair, installation, copy, quota or Git action.
No change to author, production or prior-cohort files.
No recursive dependency closure, external API/theorem/axiom audit or kernel credit.

frozen_inventory_fallback_snapshots.scope: Read only exact module/path/SHA entries for unresolved current direct imports; no recursive closure
